Currency Wars · Portals

Honkai: Star Rail Currency Wars portals: 36 entries.

  • Early EntrancePortals

    The Plot Armor selection stage has been moved up to Nodes 1-6 and 2-4.

  • Re-Re-RefreshPortals

    At the start of the First, Second, and Third Planes, respectively, gain 2, 3, and 4 free Store refreshes.

  • Plot Armor ProcurementPortals

    The Plot Armor refresh cost for this run is fixed at 1 Gold Coin(s), and you'll receive 6 free Plot Armor refreshes.
